structure.what_is_said: Elegance is how you care for your environment and yourself; calm tidy space; routines; alone time; hair, skin, nails; small intentional habits.

structure.what_is_said: She gives herself permission to grow
structure.how_it_is_shown: WHITE card

structure.what_is_said: Limiting beliefs ('I'm too old', 'I don't have the body', 'I have tattoos', 'my home is too small'); here's the truth: every elegant woman started somewhere; class is growing through mistakes; elegance is built one decision at a time.

structure.what_is_said: She carries herself with composure
structure.how_it_is_shown: WHITE card

structure.what_is_said: Composure in public; silence phone at dinner; excuse herself calmly; we've all overdone a night out, it makes us human, but not as a habit; not rigid, aware of energy; enjoy yourself while composed.

tricks: Q1 HOOK (0:00-0:30.8): 6 FULL clips, ~2-7 s each, all joined by soft dissolves (one of them 10.8 s long): Grace Kelly film (0:00), Monica Bellucci walking through a staring crowd (0:02, literal 'turn heads'), slow-mo street beauty with bangs (0:06), Grace Kelly film flash (0:13), slow-mo Paris street reel in a boater hat (0:14) carrying the title 'Episode 6 / 10 Signs of an Elegant Woman' from 0:16, dip to black at 0:21.5 on 'it,', then one calm clip (straw hat by a lake) 0:22.8-0:30.8 under 'while others may unlock small powerful shifts... Let's get started.' No other text. The hook asks a question ('can she truly call herself elegant?') and promises 'some you already have'.

Q2 POINT OPENING: last sentence of the previous sign ends over its picture -> cut/fade to WHITE -> the sign name writes on in black script while the narrator says the sign name, immediately followed by the first sentence of the body (e.g. 0:31 'She's comfortable in simplicity. One of the most subtle signs...'). Card length 4.5-5.2 s every time. Exit: the white flashes darker in 3-4 hard steps (grey, dark) about 0.2 s apart and dissolves into the caramel background with the card text still faintly visible (1:31.7, 2:52.4, 3:42.7, 4:23.9, 5:08.7, 6:23.3); card 1 (9:03) dissolves straight into the Catherine clip. Countdown order 10 -> 1.

Q2 POINT CLOSING: most signs end on a summary line made visible as a quote (sign 10 at 1:19-1:27 reel+quote; sign 9 at 2:38-2:48 reel+list; sign 7 at 4:16-4:24 caramel quote; sign 5 at 6:14-6:18 reel+quote) or on a FULL horizontal clip held 4-8 s (sign 8 model film 3:28-3:38; sign 3 candles 7:52-7:58; sign 1 slow-mo street reel 9:58-10:04).

Q3 HOLD TIMES: caramel single photo/reel 2-5 s; full-height rows 4-8 s; FULL celebrity clips 3-8 s (Catherine statement 7.8 s at 6:23). ONE creator's clip held long for a demo or a story: try-on reel 3:16.6-3:27 (10.5 s), capsule-wardrobe reel 5:10-5:23 (13.3 s), GRWM hallway reel 8:32.5-8:43 (10.8 s), 'night out' reel 9:23-9:36.5 (13.6 s). Fast montages of 1-2 s per clip for routines (7:05-7:15, 7:28-7:52, 8:44-8:57).

Q4 ROWS: mostly FULL-HEIGHT 3-panel rows (each panel ~1/3 width, thin caramel gaps), the centre panel is often a moving reel while the sides are still photos (1:46, 2:05, 4:43, 4:51, 5:42). Rows build one panel per spoken item: occasions 2:57 'coffee date' / 2:59 'business meeting' / 3:00 'formal event'; adjectives 9:37-9:41 'calm, sophisticated, intimate'. One 4-panel row (5:33-5:38 four red dresses) built one at a time on 'The bold red dress'. Panels are different women with the same idea (except the Catherine-only row 4:03-4:16 and Grace/Marilyn film row 1:57-2:04).

LIMITING-BELIEF ROWS (8:05-8:24): each quoted doubt gets a row of women who disprove it, swapped by dissolve on the words: 'I'm too old' -> older women (8:06), 'I don't have the body' -> curvy women (8:10), 'I have tattoos' -> tattooed woman (8:13), 'my home is too small' -> small stylish homes (8:17-8:24).

Q5 SMALL TEXT: none added by the editor except quotes, cards and guide text. No creator handles or credits anywhere in this video. Text seen inside clips: 'zhanlueji' (0:02-0:06), capsule reel labels such as '8. knitwear' (5:10-5:23), UN backdrop text (6:37).
